purpose: Measure whether Planner phase routing, executable-only Selector eligibility, and three fixed menu-order votes restore full-chain progress without StateTune.

change_under_test.selector_vote_rule: majority; a three-way tie uses median canonical rank, then median standardized logit, then canonical class order
change_under_test.abstain_policy: ABSTAIN remains observable in raw Head logits but is not eligible during an executable frontier

hidden_acceptance.use: post-execution strict acceptance only; unavailable during generation

fixed_metrics.success_threshold: at least one of at most three whole-chain runs passes strict acceptance
required_diagnostics: Planner patch validity and phase sequence
per-order Selector label and raw logits
action count and Executor request count
fixed_metrics.reference_similarity_role: diagnostic only; never overrides strict acceptance

stopping_rule: Stop after the first strict pass or after three whole-chain runs. If none passes, report the best run by completed audited steps, then action count, then fewer protocol rejections; do not tune weights, thresholds, prompts, or StateTune data between runs.

generation.command_template: /home/chase/.local/bin/uv run rwkv-lh-e2e --output <run_directory> --supervisor openai --supervisor-strategy goal_stages --suite agentladderv1 --case AGENT-LADDER-L1-FIX01 --max-transitions 240 --tool-disclosure-mode progressive --concurrency 1 --independent-selector --stateful-goal
generation.run_directory_policy: run_01 through run_03 are new immutable directories; never overwrite a prior run
